headlines.text: On a Wednesday in 2023, back when Orange Cassidy vs. Swerve Strickland fought tooth and nail for the AEW International Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.03 ? a fantastic contest. Battling through injuries built up over 23 straight successful defenses, Cassidy reversed a late rollup attempt from Swerve Strickland to survive and keep the International Championship.
On this day in 2024, Mina Shirakawa vs. Serena Deeb closed out Rampage, rated 5.79 with the women's division on full display.
That Wednesday in 2023, CHAOS made their first appearance under the AEW banner as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.81.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2023, Dralistico & Vance made their AEW debut as a team in a Tornado Tag match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.12 ? a well-worked match.
Rewind to 2023, when Kris Statlander vs. Anna Jay AS clashed for the AEW TBS Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.69. It was the first title opportunity of Anna Jay AS's career.
Turning the clock back to 2023: Jay White vs. Ricky Starks headlined Dynamite, rated 6.42.
